associations.rationale: The type gives only the Lie-representation adjunction with tensoring by the dual on the left; it does not also state the other adjunction required by 'both adjoints'.
The type gives only the reverse Lie-representation adjunction; it does not by itself state that tensoring by the dual is both adjoints.
